summary: E2E frontend testing of M5 Step B (SWAP mode) InjectDialog via Vite dev server with mocked window.opence (?mock=inject-clean / ?mock=inject-blocked). All 9 feature requirements from the review request pass with 0 console errors. The new 'choose-mode' phase, SWAP-mode plan summary / 'Will be swapped' warning group, ack-gated confirm, swap-mode result text, and ADD-mode regression all behave as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: InjectDialog ~351 lines, still a single-file component but readable; splitting the choose-mode screen into its own subcomponent would make phase handling clearer if the file grows further.
handleConfirm log line 'Injected X tag(s), swapped Y (Z reused)' always prints 'swapped Y' even for ADD mode (Y will be 0) - fine for debug telemetry, matches spec; no action needed.

needsAck still treats hasMismatch as a blocker (correct); in SWAP-clean the 3 external-ref 'resource-map-indexed (external)' entries land in blockedOther (not externalRefStatuses mismatch), so needsAck is triggered via blockedOther - consistent with ADD mode.

WarningGroup items are collapsed by default - the group title shows a count badge '(1)' so the item presence is observable without expanding, meeting the spec's 'check the group title + its items render' requirement.

All data-testids promised in the review request are present and stable: inject-mode-add, inject-mode-swap, inject-mode-cancel, inject-dialog-summary, inject-understand-checkbox, inject-confirm-button, inject-confirm-disabled-reason, inject-result.
verified_flows: Choose-mode phase: dialog opens on toolbar-inject-button showing inject-mode-add, inject-mode-swap, inject-mode-cancel.
Choose-mode phase closes via Escape key, × button (inject-dialog-close), and inject-mode-cancel button.

SWAP mode + ?mock=inject-clean: planInject called with 'swap', summary exactly 'From "ui" (swap mode): 0 to add, 1 to swap, 3 reused, 3 blocked'. 'Will be swapped (keeps existing tagId) (1)' section renders; expanded content includes the 'frag grenade\\shaders\\frag metal' entry.
SWAP mode + inject-clean: confirm button disabled with inject-confirm-disabled-reason='Check "I understand" below...' because blockedOther=3; checking inject-understand-checkbox enables confirm.
SWAP mode apply: result text 'Injected 0 tag(s), swapped 1 (3 reused, not duplicated).' - swappedCount renders correctly, no undefined/NaN.
SWAP mode + ?mock=inject-blocked: summary 'From "ui" (swap mode): 0 to add, 0 to swap, 1 reused, 1 blocked'; Blocked - embedded data WarningGroup present; confirm gated by understand checkbox.
ADD mode regression: inject-mode-add -> picking -> planning -> review with summary containing '(add mode)' label, existing flow unchanged.
Menu parity: menu-item-tools-inject-tags opens the new choose-mode screen (not legacy direct-to-picking).
0 console errors / 0 page errors across all SWAP, ADD, and dismiss flows.
seed_data_creation: None (uses existing dev-mock.ts + buildMockInjectPlan fixtures with 3rd mode parameter).
context_for_next_testing_agent: M5 Step B frontend is fully working in browser-mock mode. Next session will likely add Step C (per-tag conflict dialog with skip/replace/rename choice when ADD mode encounters path collisions). When Step C arrives: expect a new intermediate phase between 'planning' and 'review' that surfaces conflicts; current choose-mode screen will likely become the mode default only (per-tag override happens in conflict dialog). Toolbar testids and menu testids unchanged.
